subject: Trial account: evaluation call & quick qualification
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah@brightretail.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Interested in a quick evaluation call — trial account set up

Hi team,

I just signed up for the self-serve trial this morning (BrightRetail account created, org id: brightretail-923). We're evaluating Redwood for two main use cases:
- product search reranking and conversational product assistant embedded in our web storefront
- generating short personalized product blurbs for marketing (email snippets)

Estimated scale: ~150k tokens/day to start, peak concurrency ~30 simultaneous sessions (roughly 10–20 RPM per instance). Typical prompt length 200–400 tokens; responses 60–150 tokens.

Timeline: pilot in December, hoping to be in a limited production beta by end of Q1.

Questions before we book a call:
1) Do you support region-specific hosting for EU customers? (we'll have EU customers later)
2) Any quick guidance on cost expectations for the scale above?
3) Is there anything we need to prepare ahead of the call (sample payloads, keys)?

I attached a quick screenshot of the trial dashboard and a small CSV with one day's trial usage. Can someone on your side suggest a 20–30 minute slot early next week? Our time zone is PST.

Thanks,
Hannah Lee
Head of Product
BrightRetail

Attachments: trial-dashboard.pdf (screenshot), trial-usage-snapshot.csv
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@brightretail.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick evaluation call — trial account set up

Thanks for signing up, Hannah — and for the details, that helps a lot. I'm Aditya from SDR and I'll get you set up for a short run-through so we can verify fit and answer pricing/hosting questions.

Quick qual questions so we tailor the session:
- Which Redwood features are highest priority for the pilot: low latency for storefront chat, or cost-optimized batch generation for marketing? (You mentioned both.)
- Do you expect to hit the 150k tokens/day mostly with chat sessions or background batch jobs?
- Any compliance constraints (SOC2, HIPAA, or particular data residency requirements) that we should loop Legal on?

Proposed agenda (20 minutes):
1) 5m intro + pilot goals
2) 8–10m walk-through of the trial org + runtime profiles that match your scale
3) 5–7m next steps + pricing ballpark + Q&A

I have availability Monday (Nov 23) 10:00–12:00 PST or Tuesday 09:00–11:00 PST. If those don't work, pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-20m

Looping in Marissa, our AE, who will join to discuss pricing and pilot ops.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference

--

Hi Aditya — thanks for the quick reply.

Answers below:
- Priority: storefront chat (low latency) is the primary gating factor for Q1. Marketing generation is secondary and can be batched.
- Traffic pattern: chat sessions will account for ~75% of active traffic; batch generation ~25%.
- Compliance: we're SOC2-aligned internally and will require evidence of SOC2 scope and controls for vendor selection — no HIPAA.

Available times: Monday Nov 23 at 10:30–11:00 PST works best for us. If that slips, Tuesday 09:30–10:00 PST is the fallback.

Also, can you share a short note on expected cost range for the initial pilot (monthly) — a ballpark is fine, we just need to understand order of magnitude for budgeting.

Thanks — looking forward.
Hannah

--

Hi Hannah — Marissa here, I'll take this one and share the pilot guidance. Glad to hear storefront chat is the priority. 10:30–11:00 PST on Monday Nov 23 works for us; I've sent a calendar invite (Google Calendar link below).

Short cost guidance (ballpark for your estimated pilot):
- Baseline: at 150k tokens/day, a mixed profile with optimized batching for marketing and low-latency chat for storefront, expect mid–low thousands USD per month in net inference costs before volume discounts (rough estimate depends on model family and quantization).
- We'll run a quick model recommendation during the call (we typically show one low-latency variant for chat and a cost-optimized variant for batch jobs).

Prep items for the call:
- sample prompt + response lengths (if you can paste one example chat prompt and one marketing generation prompt in the meeting notes)
- any traffic pattern graphs from your trial (the CSV you already attached is great)

Call details: 20-min evaluation + 10-min optional deeper ops chat.
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightretail-eval-call

Looking forward — talk Monday 10:30 PST.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
